name: Mooney M22 Mustang
summary: Mooney's pressurized five-seat single, sold at a loss and built in only 36 examples. It looks like a bigger Mooney M20 with a taller tail.

wings: Low cantilever wing with no struts
Wing similar to the M20 Ranger
engines: Single turbocharged Lycoming flat-six in a large cowl
fuselage: Longer, wider fuselage than an M20 with a pressurized cabin and small windows
tail: Tall fin with a forward-raked trailing edge (the classic Mooney shape) and a large dorsal fillet

tellTales: Low-wing single with a notably tall, forward-raked tail and a long, fat body
Small cabin windows on a retractable-gear single
Tall fin with a forward-raked trailing edge

confusedWith.howToTell: The M20 has a smaller fin and a narrower fuselage; the M22 has a taller fin, a larger leading-edge fillet and a longer, wider body.
The Malibu has a conventional upright fin and a rounded fuselage; the M22 has a forward-raked fin.
The A36 has a conventional upright fin and large cabin windows; the M22 has a forward-raked tail and small windows.
